moments.text: A grey noisy screen with faint display symbols before the picture comes up.
Infrared targeting display on dark sky: a small glowing white spot sits in the tracking brackets just below the centre marker.
The display zooms in (1.0 to 2.0): the white spot grows into a fuzzy glow with a brighter core.
A brief black screen, then the sensor switches from IR to TV: a bright ring with a small dark dot below and right of centre.
TV view on grey sky: a dark oval shape, wider than tall, held steady in the brackets just below centre.
Black screen and a striped glitch, then back to infrared: the object is a bright white glow, stretched sideways.
The view zooms out: the object shrinks to a small dot held in the brackets while patches of sky drift behind it.
A short zoom in: a bright, horizontally stretched glow fills the brackets, then the view zooms back out.
The dot leaves the brackets and streaks left, growing into a bright smear before leaving the left edge. About 0.7 s; use frame step.
Grainy grey picture with empty brackets as the clip ends.

notes: Display is centre-cropped (452px pillarbox each side cut). Short black/glitch frames at 0:41, 0:43, 1:12 and 1:13.
